items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: He had Junior Ragland and Al Lucas, but Junior Ragland would get drunk, so Duke said, 'I'd better hire another bass player so I can be sure I have one.'

ctx.x: And we'd just pick up whomever the band had. At that point, I think they had Illinois Jacquet's band, and I think it was Joe Jones, who was the famous drummer with Basie, and I think Al Lucas was the bass player. So we were never in trouble.
